data.turoyo: <...> A šlomayḏi w i ḥubayḏi mqadema l məṭropoliṭ Ḥanna afandi Dolabono w xaṣṣatan hat ste bu waxt di ṣluṯo kobaʕno, d i ḥubayḏi w a šlomayḏi d mabəlġatte li ǧamaʕayḏux! <...>
data.translation: <...> Übermittelte meine Grüße und meine Liebe dem Metropoliten Ḥanna Efendi Dolaponu, und insbesondere möchte ich, daß du beim Gottesdienst meine Grüße und meine liebedeiner Gemeinde übermittelst! <...>

rationale: Adds the unusual mabəlġatte form and a complete explicit l-recipient context to the thin Infectum cell.

summary: The existing übermitteln covers greetings, love and insults as message contents. No new numbered sense or light-verb collocation is required.

The Turoyo construction distinguishes speaker/agent, message NP and recipient. At 68/46 the message is fronted and resumed, while the community recipient has l-. This supports analyzing -te as object material, but its number needs confirmation.
The ma-bəlġ- shape at 68/46 differs from entry mbaləġ; the single spelling does not establish a new III stem. Its Infectum context is dependent on kobaʕno d-.
Infectum 42/8 summarizes repeated mediation. The two monks' insults and the cook's substituted greetings establish the meaning from the Turoyo context rather than free German wording.
Confirm whether mabəlġatte (68/46) belongs to II or III and whether -te is singular/default anaphoric object material despite coordinated love and greetings.
What recipient number is encoded by kombalaġġe in 42/8? The edition's ihnen is compatible with distributive singular reference as well as the two-person discourse.
